slides.big: YOU HAVE 4 MONTHS TO DO THIS
slides.say: Moving to the Netherlands? You have four months to do this.

slides.small: Everyone who lives or works in the Netherlands must take it out.
slides.say: Everyone who lives or works in the Netherlands must take out basic health insurance.

slides.small: Do it in time and you're covered from the day you arrived.
slides.say: Do it within four months of arriving, and you're covered from the day you arrived.

slides.small: After 4 months there is no retroactive cover. Care in between, you pay yourself.
slides.say: Wait longer, and there's no cover for the gap. Any care before your policy starts, you pay yourself.

slides.small: You pay the first €385 of most covered care. GP visits don't count toward it.
slides.say: There's also a yearly deductible, called eigen risico. In twenty twenty six it's three hundred eighty five euros. G P visits don't count toward it.

slides.big: LETTER FROM THE CAK, THEN FINES
slides.small: The CAK checks everyone is insured. Ignore it and you can be fined.
slides.say: No insurance at all? You'll get a letter from the C A K, and then fines.

slides.small: Zorgtoeslag can help pay for your insurance if your income is low.
slides.say: On a low income? Check if you can get healthcare benefit, called zorgtoeslag.
